name: (EXAMPLE) Opleider
description: Fictional example set for a commercial training and coaching provider: corporate petrol with a copper accent. Not a real organisation.
provenance: an invented palette for a fictional organisation (example data, not a real brand)
_comment_source: A FICTIONAL set for demos and example data. No real school or provider uses it.
The palette is invented, so there is no upstream package and no captured
component mapping. Section C fills the whole component vocabulary from the
shared role layer, re-pointed at the ramp below.
Every ramp step a component can put text on, or under white text, is chosen
to reach WCAG AA (4.5:1) against white: the 300 and 400 steps of each family,
gray-500 and darker. gray-400 is the control border and reaches 3:1.
